realReviews.author: Emily
realReviews.text: Ben recently completed some carpentry work for me and I couldn’t be happier with the result. His workmanship was outstanding, with great attention to detail and a high standard of finish throughout. He was reliable, professional, and communicated clearly from start to finish. The job was completed on time, the work area was kept tidy, and the finished product exceeded my expectations. I would highly recommend Ben to anyone looking for quality carpentry work and will definitely be using his services again in the future.

realReviews.author: Brett Hancock
realReviews.text: Highly recommend Ben. He was always on time, kept to his schedule, did exactly what he said he would, and completed the job on budget. He always answered the phone when I called and was easy to communicate with throughout the project. The work was thorough and completed to a high standard. He was also incredibly courteous and respectful, which was greatly appreciated. Reliable, professional, and a pleasure to deal with.

realReviews.author: Kim Spring
realReviews.text: I engaged with Ben from Dynamic Carpentry and Building Solution's to replace some old polycarbonate sheeting on my back verandah. He was reliable, honest and swift with completing the job. Highly recommended !

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your reno or carpentry job?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send photos and a few details through the form, or give us a ring. We'll look at the job and send a written quote before any work starts.
Wagga Wagga and surrounds, including Uranquinty and The Rock. Not sure if you're in range? Just ask.

faq.q: Do you do full bathroom and kitchen renos?
faq.a: Yes. Ben holds a NSW contractor licence as a kitchen, bathroom and laundry renovator, so the whole reno can be handled in one go.
Yes: NSW Contractor Licence 462445C (Carpenter / Kitchen, Bathroom, Laundry Renovator).

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
